newsitem.title: USA: Cato names vice chairman, CFO.
newsitem.headline: Cato names vice chairman, CFO.

text.p: The Cato Corp said on Friday it appointed John Derham Cato as vice chairman, a new position, and chief operating officer.

Also, Alan Wiley has been promoted to senior executive vice president, chief financial and administrative officer, Cato Corp said. Wiley was formerly executive vice president, chief financial and administrative officer.
Linda McFarland Jenkins, who previously held the title of chief operating officer, will remain as president and chief merchandising officer, Cato said.

Cato Corp said the move to shake up its management was to restore the retailer's profitable revenue growth and address a number of business issues, including merchandising, that have hurt its performance.
